name: Hub help
description: Help mode entries (help@1) for the Hub plugin: the view, each tab of the hub.tabs row and the settings sub-tab.
author: Brett

entries.title: Hub
entries.text: Every axHub page in the console: approvals, the log, passes and veto, users, your account, connectors and services, handoff, auth admin and app downloads. Pick a tab; each screen is also a deep link, a REST read, an MCP tool, a CLI line and a voice action.

entries.title: Hub
entries.text: Whether this browser is signed in to axHub, how many calls wait, and one tap to sign in or out.

entries.title: Approvals
entries.text: Every call axHub is holding or asking about, with its countdown. Approve, Deny and Shelve are your own tap; no session can press them.

entries.title: Approval log
entries.text: Every request the hub asked about, how it was decided and what happened after, with filters for service, tool, who and outcome.

entries.title: Passes and veto
entries.text: Timed passes that let calls run without the veto wait, the go pass for sessions that cannot reach axHub, and the veto countdown. Granting is your own tap.

entries.title: Users
entries.text: Who can sign in to the hub and what each account may open. Role changes, disabling and deleting ask you to confirm.

entries.title: Account
entries.text: Your hub account: name and email, password, signed-in browsers, the linked phone and notification preferences.

entries.title: Apps and connectors
entries.text: Every connected service with its status, its tools and their policies (allow, veto, confirm), and the health of its keys. Open a row for the service detail.

entries.title: Handoff
entries.text: Claude account handoff kits the hub built: open one, send it to a session and mark it sent.

entries.title: Auth admin
entries.text: OAuth clients, API tokens and sign-in methods. A token is shown once when created and never stored in the console.

entries.title: Apps
entries.text: Every app the framework's CI built, with a download each.

entries.title: Hub settings
entries.text: Settings → Plugins → Hub: every setting the axHub web app used to keep, now in the console (how often the hub is read, grid columns, log filters, grant-pass defaults, the veto countdown). No wait stays in Claude settings and shows here read-only.

entries.title: Approve
entries.text: Lets the call run (a held call runs at once). Your own tap in your signed-in browser; no session, tool or voice command can press it.

entries.title: Deny
entries.text: Stops the call. Your own tap; a denied call never runs.

entries.title: Shelve
entries.text: Pauses a held call's countdown until you decide. Your own tap.

entries.title: Check now
entries.text: Reads axHub again at once. Every screen re-reads on its own while open.

entries.title: Grant a pass
entries.text: Switches a timed pass on: calls it covers run without the veto wait until it ends. Your own tap; a session can only ask (it shows here with Grant).

entries.title: Revoke
entries.text: Ends a pass now. Tap twice: the second tap carries the server's confirm token.

entries.title: Veto countdown
entries.text: How long a held call counts down before it runs. Changing it writes the new hold onto every tool axHub holds for a veto (a confirm through your hub session).

entries.title: Hub notices on the phone
entries.text: When on, a new call waiting on axHub is sent once to your phone through Phone Connect; the notice opens this console's Approvals screen on that request.

entries.title: Approvals toolbar
entries.text: The screen's commands (check the hub now, stop auto-approve, tell the phone) and jumps to the log and passes. Three looks to pick from: standard, dense, grouped. Deciding stays on the rows.

entries.title: Phone Connect
entries.text: Opens Phone Connect's settings, where your phone is paired. Hub notices open this console's Approvals screen on it.

entries.title: Notification settings
entries.text: Opens Claude settings → Notifications: what reaches your phone and when. The hub reads the same values.

entries.title: Current password
entries.text: Your hub password as it is now; the hub checks it before changing anything.

entries.title: New password
entries.text: The new hub password (at least the hub's minimum length). Your own tap sends it; the console never stores it.

entries.title: New password again
entries.text: The new password once more, so a typo does not lock you out.

entries.title: Change password
entries.text: Changes your hub password. Your own tap in your signed-in browser; it goes to axHub through your session.

entries.title: Newer
entries.text: The newer page of requests.

entries.title: Older
entries.text: The older page of requests.

entries.title: Users
entries.text: Jumps to the Users screen: accounts, roles and permissions.

entries.title: I have copied it
entries.text: Hides the token just created. It is shown once; the console does not keep it.

entries.title: Scopes (comma-separated)
entries.text: What the token may do on the hub, comma-separated. Empty = the hub's default.

entries.title: Expires in (days)
entries.text: How many days until the token stops working.

entries.title: Create a token
entries.text: Creates an API token on the hub and shows its secret once. Your own tap. Today's hub has no token admin route yet: it says so.

entries.title: Client name
entries.text: The OAuth client's name as sign-in screens will show it.

entries.title: Redirect URIs (comma-separated)
entries.text: Where the hub may send a browser back after an OAuth sign-in, comma-separated.

entries.title: Add a connector
entries.text: Asks the hub to add a connector. axHub configures services in its own command line today, so this says what to run there.

entries.title: Its calls in the log
entries.text: Opens the approval log on this service's calls.

entries.title: Policy
entries.text: What a tool may do: allow (runs at once), veto (runs after a countdown unless you deny it), confirm (waits for your approval), deny; or follow the service.

entries.title: Send: copy the prompt and mark sent
entries.text: Copies the handoff prompt for the new account's session and marks the run sent on the hub.

entries.title: Accept on this device
entries.text: Accepts the handoff on this device. Waits on the hub protocol; today the hub says it has no route for it.

entries.title: Requests
entries.text: Back to the Approvals screen (every request).

entries.title: Download JSON
entries.text: Downloads the whole approval log as JSON from the hub, under your hub sign-in.

entries.title: Service
entries.text: Narrows the log to one service (a tool's namespace, such as vps or github).

entries.title: Tool
entries.text: Narrows the log to one tool.

entries.title: Outcome
entries.text: Narrows the log to one outcome (approved, declined, expired, ran …).

entries.title: Decided
entries.text: Narrows the log by how a request was decided: not decided, on the web, in the terminal, automatically, other.

entries.title: Pass
entries.text: Narrows the log to calls that ran under a timed pass, or one pass.

entries.title: The request
entries.text: Opens that request on the Approvals screen.

entries.title: Ran under a pass
entries.text: Opens the approval log on the calls that ran under a pass.

entries.title: min from now
entries.text: Extends the pass so it ends that many minutes from now.

entries.title: Its calls
entries.text: Opens the approval log on the calls that ran under this pass.

entries.title: Grant min
entries.text: Grants the pass a session asked for, as asked. Your own tap; the session could only ask.

entries.title: Scope (control@1 target; * matches anything)
entries.text: Which control@1 targets the pass covers (tokens.theme, tokens.*; * matches anything).

entries.title: Tools (empty = every tool in the scope)
entries.text: Which tools the pass covers; empty = every tool in the scope. Destructive tools never run under a pass.

entries.title: Note (optional, shown in the pass)
entries.text: A line shown in the go pass, for the sessions that read it.

entries.title: Go for h
entries.text: Gives the go pass for that many hours: sessions that cannot reach axHub may work. Your own tap.

entries.title: Reset every remembered value
entries.text: Puts every value the Hub screens remember (grid columns, log filters, grant defaults, poll) back to the route table's default.

entries.title: Username
entries.text: The new account's sign-in name on the hub.

entries.title: Temporary password
entries.text: A first password they replace at their first sign-in; it stops working after three days.

entries.title: Save name and email
entries.text: Saves the account's name and email on the hub.

entries.title: Another permission
entries.text: A permission id not in the list (console.plugin.<folder> …); Add puts it in the set, Save permissions writes it.

entries.title: Set a temporary password
entries.text: A temporary password for this account; they pick their own at next sign-in. Your own tap; never stored here.

entries.title: Set password
entries.text: Sends the temporary password to the hub. Your own tap.
